title: polypodium lineare var. onoei
intro: Polypodium lineare var. onoei, commonly known as Japanese polypody, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium lineare var. onoei include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various compounds such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
